reviewer_scope: Independently read all 136 nonretail paragraphs and every one of the 114 cited own-date headline records. Checked concrete assertions, attribution, Polish translations, actual-versus-preview status, source ages, and conditional scenarios. Compared every quoted market/Treasury level and return with its correct own-date instrument, session, horizon, and unit. Re-read all six edited strings and reran the own-date verifier. No later-date factual source justified an August 1 claim.

basis: The US chapter compares the Treasury curve with S&P/Russell performance and current GDP/employment evidence, distinguishing easing from demand collapse.

China separately connects PMI, retail demand, lending, property, trade friction and company economics; market rebounds are compared with the twenty-session decline and bounded hedge-fund allocation evidence.
Poland combines inflation protection, unemployment, fiscal procedure, grocery margins, gaming, energy-project stage, governance and security, with issuer-specific price comparisons.

Sector stances vary with actual company evidence: Meta advertising versus Microsoft cloud disappointment, defensive-staple result dispersion, aircraft servicing versus Airbus costs, and semiconductor upgrades versus reaction risk.
Scenarios preserve pending Apple/Palantir earnings and conditional central-bank guidance. Themes and catalysts have distinct operating drivers and observable invalidation conditions.

findings.action: Reworded both Lineage references to a debut share-price response. The headline does not establish documented offering subscription demand.
Added local unemployment support to Poland synthesis, a Yahoo tag to its price comparison, and a Treasury tag beside the curve characterization.
Changed the unsupported Palantir AI characterization into the own-headline-supported valuation debate before earnings.

July 31 Fed/BOJ decisions precede the August 1 cutoff. Apple and Palantir remain previews. Report-date US/Chinese/European PMI outcomes are absent. Company results and source reactions remain within exact headline scope.

The July 18 ECB headline supports the completed unchanged-rate decision and its data-dependent current policy baseline within 35 days; the text does not assert a later decision or a specific future meeting date.

All quoted observations use July 31 completed sessions; crypto uses the completed UTC candle. The 2Y/10Y yields, negative spread, and bull-steepening description agree with Treasury data. Numeric spot-FX is absent. Returns are price changes and quoted percentages retain the correct horizon.

limits: Evidence consists of exact dated headline records and current-vintage historical market cards, not full publisher article bodies or original unrevised data vintages.
This acceptance binds the exact current nonretail component only. Retail is reviewed independently; subsequent edits require renewed review and binding.

exact_block_ranges.method: Independent paragraph-body whitespace count after removing canonical citation tokens; all36 exact AUTHORING bounds.
